## Global budgets

| Budget | Metric · target · condition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Accessibility — Client-facing surfaces | WCAG 2.2 AA conformance · every Client-facing surface · at launch, with keyboard-only completion of every primary journey | Olena, 2026-07-09 |
| Platform availability | Client-facing surfaces reachable · 99.5% · of each calendar month | Olena, 2026-07-09 |
| Localization | Client-facing copy externalised · all of it · from the first release, single locale at launch | canvas §9 Localization |
| Scale | Carried load · 200 Specialists and 10,000 Appointments per month · at launch volumes | Olena, 2026-07-09 |

## UX & interaction conventions

| Convention | Statement | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Phone-first Client surfaces | Client-facing pages are designed phone-first; desktop is secondary | canvas §6 Forms |
| Destructive acts | A cancellation is confirmed in one explicit step that names what is being cancelled | Olena, 2026-07-09 |
| Time rendering | Times are rendered in the Specialist's published timezone, with the timezone named | call 2026-07-14 |
| Glossary-canonical interface copy | Interface text uses glossary-canonical terms — Appointment, Slot, Specialist — never synonyms | glossary discipline (#2) · kickoff notes |
